description:
What hashn keeps of one file, oldest first: `receipts` (size, SHA-256 fingerprint, who, when; any
        file) and, for markdown records with a YAML header, `versions` (fields and body). Since 2026-11-21 hashn
        keeps a file as it is now and what was agreed, not every save: you see the saves before that day, any agreed
        version, and the current one.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

path.description: The file whose saves and versions you want.
path.title: Path

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
